1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto perenne de 6 m de altura, de tronco fino, de corteza color castaño, hojas opuestas elípticas, ligeramente carnosas, que brotan en pequeñas ramas; su fruto blanquecino y acuoso no es comestible. Chloranthaceae Hedyosmum arborescens.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial shrub of 6 m in height, with a slender trunk, brownish bark, opposite elliptical leaves that are slightly fleshy and emerge on small branches; its whitish and watery fruit is not edible. Chloranthaceae Hedyosmum arborescens.
